title: A Pick/Order Parts role can edit the Quantity on the Part Requests tab
custom_preconds:
1. A custom role has Work orders View (Create & Edit and Delete OFF), Work order lines View only, and Pick parts ON, with a user assigned.
  2. A work order has an authorized line and an inventory-sourced part request.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the Pick-Parts user and open the work order.
Go to the Part Requests tab and expand the line.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The part request row and its Quantity field are shown.

custom_steps_separated.content: Check whether the Quantity field can be edited.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Quantity field is editable for the Pick-Parts role, even without Work orders Create & Edit.
